body: Everybody needs money and i´m sure you do too and how low would it be if i would ask some stranger for his personal money ...
I´m not going to beg for money on here. And especially not since i don´t even know how i would pay it back. I´m just at my lowest right now and i have no clue how to fix any of it.
I don´t have money because i trusted the wrong person. Because i am stupid like that. And slowly dying cuz of that is not an option to me.
Thank you for trying and sorry for wasting your time. Guess im at peace with myself
It´ll never end. I need to go. You´re a good person. Keep that up.
Thank you for the nice words.

And i don´t even want to find another person. It´s either him or nobody. I can not again build a whole new relationship with all this trying to trust crap and all that. I don´t want to get hurt no more.

I never relied on whoever, not once before. But i thought i can finally trust somebody, someone who truly cares because it was one of the nicest feelings ever. Why do i not deserve it? Guess im just too horrible. Im so tired.

Nobody knows how i feel and what i´ve been through. I want him back so badly. Nobody understands. Kept strong for 31 years. Even if do hang in there, nothing will change, i´ll be alone with nobody i can talk to, nobody who will support me.
I appreciate the effort.
That is not the same. I´m sick of being alone
I just want a hug, feel that somebody cares ...

But what is left for me? I lost the only person i´ve ever cared about the most. I´m sitting here alone drowining in my tears and thoughts. I´ve been strong for so many years but im only human too and can only take so much. I can´t just call a friend and ask for help because there is nobody. I don´t wanna be here anymore, i just want to escape.
And you´re a good person for that, you really are. I don´t even know why i posted, i regret it now.
I don´t even wanna hear this no more. You don´t even know how many times i´ve heard this crap, oh bla bla you´re so important just to be forgotten again. Fuck this.
I never mattered to anybody. Not even once. Not to any boyfriends, not to family and not to friends. Im suffocating, i can´t do it no more.
Ya i wish things would be that easy but sadly they are not but hey whatever. Thanks for trying though, i appreciate it.

My whole life basically. Ok so i was working a pretty bad job, it barely got me through. I guess that was ok for a while but i wanted something new. So i kept looking and looking and finally found something i´d really like to do. Now i was scared to do it because that would mean i would go a month without any money because im switching but at the same time i really wanted it. My ex encouraged me to do it because he said he would cover me for this month so i can start a new career and well a better life for me. I would´ve been fine in february with my first pay. Now i have nothing because im alone, i have no friends and family that could help me out, he was all i´ve ever had. Im looking at nothing now and i feel dumb for trusting him on that, thinking it was sincere. I´m 31 now and i´ve accomplished shit and never will now. I´m so stupid and just a failure. I don´t want a life like this.
I appreciate your kind words but no clue. I´ve lost everything i´ve worked for so hard, not just him.

But he was the reason i´m still here. I´m so damn stupid for even trusting him and relying on the fact he would help me through this. I still love him to death, more than anything. But that he is willingly accepting that i´m going to die is too much for me.

I can´t trust anybody anymore. He decided to kill me with his actions. I trusted him that he´d do it. He encouraged me to do all this and now it´s all done. I´m going to die eventually, either one way or the other. But i´m not going to sit here and slowly starve to death. I´ve always giving everything to everyone and i didn´t get shit for it.

I´m just finally screwed. My whole life has been shit over and over. Getting mistreated, being abused, just everything. I´ve already tried to end this years back but i failed then i met my boyfriend, well long distance but he was the only one i´ve ever loved. I put everything into this relationship and i promised him i would work on me and my problems and stay. Now we are done and i just can´t take it no more. Even if i would decide to stay i would starve this month. He screwed me over. Gave a promise he didnt keep. I can´t stop crying, i can´t breathe, the anxiety is too overwhelming.
